name: Rapid

system.description: A creature afflicted with Rapid ignores the @Affliction[delay] on their @Trait[flinch-XY] Attacks as though they lack the Trait AND may trigger the Resolution to @Trait[set-up] Actions as a Free Action following completion of the Set Up.
